name: Disassemble ZEBRONICS M.2 SSD Enclosure
transcript:
[3.5-7.6s] First,first we will unwrap this and we will take out of the cover
[18.5-24.1s] then we will first open the the top one screw with the screwdriver
[46.1-51.3s] then we will ultimately ultimately take out the top nib of this.
[51.9-53.3s] as it looks in the video
[54.7-73.9s] it has the screwdriver in this   next we will open from the the back  here we have just one screw screw again we have to open this
[84.2-99.4s] once you successfully open open this you can see it the nut screw is here and this component is separate here now just from the front we need to tilt a tilt a bit and this will come out.

steps.action: Remove the enclosure from the plastic sleeve
steps.expected_end_state: The enclosure is out of the plastic sleeve and held up; the sleeve is pushed aside

steps.action: Unscrew and remove the top cap (USB-C end, silver stripe side)
steps.expected_end_state: The top cap is fully off and the USB-C end next to the silver stripe is open

steps.action: Unscrew and remove the bottom cap (end without the silver stripe)
steps.expected_end_state: The bottom cap is fully off and the end away from the silver stripe is open

steps.action: Slide the inner PCB out of the housing
steps.expected_end_state: The black PCB is fully out of the aluminium housing; PCB and empty housing are shown separately
